cards.card_text: God names the fasts of the fourth, the fifth, the seventh and the tenth months.
cards.verse_text: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: The fasts of the fourth, the fifth, the seventh, and the tenth months will become times of joy and gladness, cheerful feasts for the house of Judah.
